note: ADR 1141: a delegated handler of a control disabled from mount whose spreads have proven keys without disabled (an attribute handler beside {...rest}, a spread literal's onClick, an input's onKeyDown) never runs: no diagnostic, the SC4001 rows are obligations (handler-on-disabled-control). SpreadStillRuns: a spread that writes disabled back, a spread whose keys are not proven (disabled false at run time), a spread's onWheel (not delegated) and the driven twin report NO_OWNER_EFFECT.
